Ready, Viktor?

Drive, munch small objects, and grow! Drag to steer. Release to slow. Bigger vehicles can collect bigger targets.

🚜 Farm: the T tunnel links the city and Sunny Acres. Chickens give turbo; watch for Bigfoot!

⚓ Ocean: drive to the end of the city dock marked D to become a tugboat. Collect boats and floating cargo. The big gold R whirlpool returns to the city.

🌙 Moon base: drive onto the rocket pad (gold square on your map) at ANY size. Become a lunar rover! The gold L lander returns you to the world you launched from. Size, score, and each map’s progress carry over.

🌀 Corner rings teleport across your current map. Catch golden targets for extra growth. At MEGA size, recover 10 cats, bunnies, turtles, or probes to unlock your bonus vehicle!

☢ After three minutes, catch the bomb carrier within 10 seconds at any size for +1,000 points. Finish active chases before traveling. Restart rebuilds every map.

🎧 Sound controls effects and radio. On the Moon, Radio toggles real Apollo recordings separately.
